overall_summary: Analysis of the historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife complexities and everyday familial realities, significantly outperform abstract poetry or generic sad shayari. Content focusing on shared domestic life and mutual understanding achieves 5x to 10x higher views than general emotional quotes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) heavily outperform generic shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more narratives on partner dynamics, unspoken expectations, and emotional distance in marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles addressing relational truths directly ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' with 382 views) perform better than one-liner sad poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Use dialogue-based or realization-based hooks that challenge common relationship assumptions.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or abstract poetry; ground the emotion in tangible, everyday life situations.
